## A quantitative foundation. A practical focus.

I’m drawn to problems people encounter in everyday work: repetitive tasks, difficult processes, and information that needs to be clearer. My projects combine analysis, workflow improvement, and reusable tools with guidance that helps people use them.

**Tools:** Python · Pandas · NumPy · SQL/MySQL · Excel · Stata · EViews · R
